question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Copious
solution:
The correct answer is** "Meagre."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Copious"** means abundant or plentiful. (बड़ी मात्रा में; प्रचुर, भरपूर)

 
 
• **Example:** *She made **copious**__ notes at the lecture.*
 
 
 
• **"Meagre"** means lacking in quantity or quality. (बहुत कम, स्‍वल्‍प)
 __
 
• **Example**: *She has a **meagre**__ salary.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the antonym of **copious** is** meagre**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (Galore)** means in abundance or plentifully. (बड़ी संख्‍या या मात्रा में)
 
• **Option 2 (Enough)** means sufficient or adequate. (पर्याप्त, काफ़ी, जितना (मात्रा या संख्‍या) आवश्‍यक हो उतना)
 
• **Option 3 (Unsparing)** means generous or giving freely. (उदार या स्वतंत्र रूप से देना)
